design.site_summary: A partial shade balcony with high moisture from a dripping air-conditioner, housing one dog.
design.layout_strategy: The planting is structured vertically with trailing plants in hanging baskets near the ceiling, mid-level upright shrubs and foliage containers against the wall, and a protected ground-level grazing patch for the beagle.
design.combination_logic: The combination pairs broad, patterned tropical foliage with fine-textured herbs and bold shrubs, creating a rich contrast in leaf shapes and textures. Throughout the year, evergreen foliage provides a lush base while seasonal blooms and aromatic herbs add fragrance and color shifts.

zones.placement: on the north-facing railing, receiving indirect partial shade and constant high moisture.

plants.why: Thrives in high moisture and shade, trailing beautifully.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides a spilling, cascading element that softens the hard lines of the railing and contrasts with upright mid-level plants.

maintenance: Water weekly to ensure soil remains evenly moist.
Prune trailing stems back by a third in spring to encourage bushier growth.

zones.placement: against the interior wall under the dripping air-conditioner outlet, in partial shade.

plants.why: Loves high moisture and partial shade conditions.
plants.role_in_combination: Acts as the structural focal point with large blooms and broad leaves that contrast against fine foliage.
Brings striking patterned foliage that adds tropical depth and color contrast at mid-level.

maintenance: Keep soil constantly moist due to the AC drip.
Feed with a balanced liquid fertilizer monthly during spring and summer.
Prune dead hydrangea stems back in late winter.

zones.placement: on the floor in a protected corner, easily reachable by the beagle in partial shade.

plants.why: Grows vigorously in moist soil and is safe for dogs to nibble.
plants.role_in_combination: Offers a tactile, aromatic ground-level experience that satisfies the beagle's urge to forage safely.

maintenance: Water as needed to maintain soil moisture.
Cut back aggressively after summer flowering to promote fresh, tender growth.

care_instructions.task: Check drainage around the air-conditioner catch area to prevent stagnant waterlogging
Prune back overgrown stems on the Inch Plant and Lemon Balm
Apply organic liquid fertilizer to the mid-level containers

care_cautions: Constant dripping from the air-conditioner may cause root rot in the Mid-Level Jungle Wall pots if drainage holes become blocked.
The beagle may over-excavate or trample the Safe Grazing Patch if the Lemon Balm is not allowed to establish sturdy root systems first.
design.pet_safety_note: The design isolates toxic or delicate plants in hanging and mid-level zones, while providing a dedicated, dog-safe Lemon Balm patch at ground level for the beagle to explore.
